name: thesis-mcwm-controlled-calibration-v10-20261021
trust: Unchanged original action_model trust and eight-update rule; endpoint and 58-column candidates are passive on the same new common trajectory.
selection: First jointly executable diagnostic-station issue in each300s window, on any affected line. Seed-fixed low/high blocks consumed by successful issues separately per line and train/heldout role. No outcome-based selection.
budget: 57 packets x5 distinct issue slots=285; at most one calibration bundle replaces an ordinary global slot per packet. Several endpoint fields do not create extra supervised issue rows. Zero-duration global slots never enter learned global fitting. Retain456policy updates and24000native seconds per day.
physical_covariate: Reuse fixed102source physical intervals. No extra unbudgeted target physical labels. The new endpoint models use only selected controlled bundles.
endpoint_clock: Action issue and next-stop event delivery use actual native ledger clocks. Native bridge detects an event before finishing its tick, then delivers it one tick later; detection and delivery clocks are recorded separately. Fixed300 is sampled after the exact native tick.
common_prefix: One new trajectory shared by base,58-column comparator and endpoint candidate per day. Controlled commands and selected slots deliberately differ from v7-v9; no old truth is used.
evaluation: Issue-time predictions before feedback; train/before9000,train/after9000 and heldout/after18000 reported separately. All fitting stops at18000. Heldout endpoints are evaluation observations and never enter285training labels.
scope: Development coverage and response-endpoint pilot. Chosen-action errors and randomized group differences are not paired same-state action-effect truth, and this pilot does not compare deployed candidate policies.

independent_confirmation.gate: Review selected diagnostic-station coverage at both actions per line, prequential endpoint errors and raw versus analytic global action response by stable/shock and train/heldout. Missing action support blocks advancement. A successful analytic zero-duration override alone cannot qualify the candidate. New paired native truth is required before a causal action-direction or control-benefit claim.
